nodes.summary: For a finite list $E$ of ordered pairs of natural numbers and natural numbers $u$ and $v$, the directed adjacency of $u$ to $v$ in $E$ is the boolean value that is true exactly when the pair $(u, v)$ occurs in $E$.
nodes.title: Directed adjacency for HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED)

nodes.summary: The decision problem HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED) accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to an instance $(n, E)$, consisting of a natural number $n$ and a finite list $E$ of ordered pairs of natural numbers, such that $(n, E)$ is well formed ($n > 0$, $E$ has no repeated entries, and every pair $(u, v)$ in $E$ satisfies $u < n$, $v < n$ and $u \ne v$) and has a…
nodes.title: The directed Hamiltonian cycle decision problem

nodes.summary: An instance $(n, E)$ of HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED), with $n$ a natural number and $E$ a finite list of ordered pairs of natural numbers, has a directed Hamiltonian cycle when there is a list $(v_0, \dots, v_{n-1})$ of $n$ distinct natural numbers containing every natural number below $n$ such that the pair $(v_j, v_{(j+1) \bmod n})$ occurs in $E$ for every $j < n$.
nodes.title: Directed Hamiltonian cycles of an instance

nodes.summary: An instance of HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED) is a pair $(n, E)$ of a natural number $n$, the number of vertices, and a finite list $E$ of ordered pairs of natural numbers, the arcs.
nodes.title: Instances of HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED)

nodes.summary: The decision problem HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED) belongs to NP, and every decision problem $L$ in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
nodes.title: HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED) is NP-complete

nodes.summary: An instance $(n, E)$ of HAMILTONIAN CYCLE (DIRECTED), with $n$ a natural number and $E$ a finite list of ordered pairs of natural numbers, is well formed when $n > 0$, the list $E$ has no repeated entries, and every pair $(u, v)$ in $E$ satisfies $u < n$, $v < n$ and $u \ne v$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
